title: Fixed Unequal Radius Post and Vented Control Plinth
description: One newly authored complete fixed luthier-bending-iron-inspired exterior. A whole upright metal-look post has one continuous convex unequal-radius egg-like section, long vertical sides and a shallow full upper-edge chamfer with closed top. The broad noncircular forming post roots through one complete four-corner flange with four full fixed headed fasteners into a low hollow control plinth. That entire plinth has three genuine rectangular through-wall vents on each side, an empty interior, complete top and bottom walls and one whole unmarked front control. A separate full chamfered ground sole supports the case. All section functions, solids, cavities, vent layout, flange, bolt profiles and whole arrangement are newly numerically authored. This is not the earlier inclined hand iron in a separate helical rest with attached looped cord and side-by-side control case, nor a horizontal hollow goffering barrel around an inserted rod on a cranked stem. Here the full upright broad varying-radius post itself is the central body above a ventilated low base; no earlier mesh, pole, barrel, coil, case or hand grip is imported, extracted or resized. Nine closed editable complete meshes, four opaque constant untextured PBR roles, metres native Z up and whole horizontal-bounds-centred ground sole. One original model zero scenes. Broad craft-tool category art only, not a branded product, replica, measured device or construction plan. The post is a closed solid appearance with no heating element or internal electrical system; the case vents are real visual empty paths, not a cooling-performance claim. Fasteners deliberately overlap fixed roots and have no threaded travel. No cable, electrical supply, operating temperatures, heat, wet wood, forming strap, actual bending, material suitability, thermal simulation, electrical design, calibration, load, stability, handling, ergonomics, manufacture or equipment safety is provided or verified. No rig, animation or interaction.
